roster.name: ISA Abstract Model
roster.description: Conceptual data model for describing Investigations, Studies and Assays (ISA). Defines core entities (Investigation, Study, Assay, Materials, Processes, Protocols, Factors, etc.) and their relationships; serves as the canonical abstract specification that ISA serializations implement.

roster.name: ISA-Tab format
roster.description: A tab-delimited file format implementing the ISA Abstract Model for representing investigation/study/assay metadata as a set of interrelated text tables (i_investigation, s_*, a_*, etc.). Used for exchanging and submitting experimental metadata; examples and many .txt manifest files are included in the seed material.

roster.name: ISA-JSON format
roster.description: A JSON serialization of the ISA Abstract Model defined by JSON Schemas and content rules (schemas for investigation, study, assay, sample, process, ontology_annotation, etc.). Includes encoding rules (UTF‑8, ISO8601 dates), schema files, and examples for valid ISA-JSON documents.
